Yeah I meant to do that, basically we didn't support the case where we'd call `createElement` with children as spread arguments. With the introduction of the banner, this code (I shortened it but a is the banner and b is the list of hits) : ```jsx
{a && } {b && }
``` Gets transformed to : ```js createElement('div', {}, a && createElement(A), b && createElement(B)) ``` Which isn't something we ever supported, so this is more of a bug fix I guess.
